newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Rebels execute three men in the Philippines.
newsitem.headline: Rebels execute three men in the Philippines.

text.p: An Islamic rebel firing squad on Wednesday publicly executed three men in a southern Philippine town for killing a guerrilla and stealing his car, rebels and police said.

Scores of residents of Munai town in Lanao del Norte province, 800 km (500 miles) south of Manila, witnessed the execution by about a dozen guerrillas of the Moro Islamic Liberation Front (MILF), they said.

MILF brigade commander Yaya Luksadatu reported the execution to journalists in Marawi and Colonel Timbanatao Pandapatan, commander of a police mobile force, said his informants in the area had confirmed it.

According to two local reporters who said they saw the execution, the three men were tied to bamboo poles in front of a public school and shot with assault rifles by guerrillas wearing veils with eye slits.
Luksadatu said the three men were found guilty of killing an MILF member and stealing his car on January 2.
The MILF, a breakaway insurgent group fighting for an Islamic state in the southern Mindanao region, is holding peace talks with the government.
The mainstream Moro National Liberation Front (MNLF) signed a peace agreement with Manila last October, ending a 24-year MNLF-led revolt for Moslem autonomy in the southern islands.
